categories.description: Category ids from the user-defined catalog (filled in at prompt time). Match by name OR id (case-insensitive). Empty / omitted means "no category filter".

fits.description: Subset of allowed fit buckets. Omitted means "no fit filter".

scoredBy.description: Subset of allowed scorer ids. "claude" = LLM-scored (any provider). "none" = unscored.

sources.description: Subset of allowed corpus sources. "manual" = user-added via "+ Add Job".

priority.description: Tri-state on priority-company flag. "yes" narrows to priority only.

applied.description: Tri-state on the application-tracker flag. "no" = not-yet-applied.

scoreMin.description: Integer 1-10. Combined with scoreMax to form a closed range.

scoreMax.description: Integer 1-10. Combined with scoreMin to form a closed range.

dateQuick.description: "24h" / "7d" / "30d" map to the same buckets the UI quick-filter offers. "custom" is reserved for the date-picker — the LLM should not emit it.

search.description: Free-text keyword matched against job title / company / fit-reasons. Extract specific tech/product nouns only — do not dump the whole query here.
